promptText: When an owner wants a collection or soft-brand option for a hotel conversion in Mexico, which brands are commonly considered?
rawText:
Here are the most commonly considered **soft brands** or **“collection”** options for hotel conversions in Mexico—especially appealing to owners seeking to retain a property's unique identity while benefiting from a major chain’s distribution, loyalty programs, and standards:

IHG (InterContinental Hotels Group)  
- **Vignette Collection** – A luxury & lifestyle soft brand designed for independent properties with distinct character. It’s especially popular for conversions in Latin America, including Mexico ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai)).  
- **voco hotels** – A premium brand aimed at mid-sized independent properties and conversions. It has been actively used in the region ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Garner hotels** – A midscale, conversion-friendly brand that emphasizes cost-efficiency and rapid rebranding ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Ruby** – A premium urban-lifestyle "micro" brand suitable for adaptive reuse and conversions, launched in early 2025 ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Noted Collection** – A newer premium collection (launched February 2026), targeted at upscale-to-upper upscale independent hotels, being explored in EMEAA currently but indicative of IHG’s emphasis on collection brands for conversions ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Files/I/Ihg-Plc/results/2026/full-year-2025/full-year-results-for-the-year-to-31-dec-2025.pdf?utm_source=openai)).

IHG’s conversion-friendly brands have driven significant expansion in Latin America, particularly in Mexico, where they accounted for 25–30% of new development deals in recent years ([expansion.mx](https://expansion.mx/empresas/2023/03/22/ihg-apuesta-segmento-de-lujo?utm_source=openai)).

Marriott International  
- **Autograph Collection** – A well-known soft brand for mid-to-upper upscale independent hotels that maintain unique design and identity while joining Marriott’s distribution and loyalty ecosystem ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Tribute Portfolio** – Another Marriott soft brand tailored for lifestyle-focused independents that prefer more flexibility in standards ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Design Hotels** – Focused on design-led independent properties with strong cultural or aesthetic identities ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)).  
- **The Luxury Collection** – A high-end soft brand typically used for historic, iconic hotels and palaces—one of the original soft brands in the industry ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/Article-24483?utm_source=openai)).

Hilton Worldwide  
- **Curio Collection** – A soft brand enabling independent boutique hotels to retain character while leveraging Hilton’s global platform. Examples include properties in Mexico such as *The Fives Downtown Hotel & Residences* ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Tapestry Collection** – Another soft brand for unique independent properties seeking Hilton affiliation without losing individuality ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Spark by Hilton** – A relatively new brand launched in Mexico in February 2025 as a **premium economy/conversion-focused brand** aimed at mid-size and emerging cities; especially tailored for converting existing hotels into the Hilton system ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spark_by_Hilton?utm_source=openai)).

Hyatt  
- **Unbound Collection** – Designed for independent, lifestyle-oriented luxury hotels seeking Hyatt affiliation ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
- **JdV by Hyatt** – Another soft collection offering for independent boutique hotels to join Hyatt’s distribution network ([hospitality.today](https://www.hospitality.today/article/marriotts-soft-brands-are-a-distribution-strategy-not-a-brand-strategy?utm_source=openai)).

Other notable soft brands recognized in the Mexican and broader Latin American markets:  
- **Ascend Hotel Collection** (Choice Hotels) – One of the earliest soft brands, offering flexible affiliation for independents ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Trademark Hotel Collection** (Wyndham) – A soft brand choice for independent hotels wanting to preserve their identity under Wyndham’s umbrella ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).  
- **Gamma** – A Mexican soft brand under Posadas, offering a more regionally-focused soft brand option ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

In summary, owners converting hotels in Mexico often consider the following soft-brand affiliations:

- **IHG**: Vignette Collection, voco, Garner hotels, Ruby, Noted Collection  
- **Marriott**: Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Design Hotels, The Luxury Collection  
- **Hilton**: Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, Spark by Hilton  
- **Hyatt**: Unbound Collection, JdV by Hyatt  
- **Choice/Wyndham/Local**: Ascend Collection, Trademark Collection, Gamma (Posadas)

Each brand offers a different mix of flexibility, service level, investment requirements, and distribution strength. Owners typically weigh factors such as brand standards, conversion cost, target market positioning, and the loyalty network when choosing which soft brand to align with.
